purpose: Verify storage compatibility without changing Agent behavior or treating synthetic labels as historical Golden annotations.

annotation_audit.holdout_policy: Do not execute for tuning; holdout cases are selected20 holdout only.
annotation_audit.approval_scope: Five approvals cover question/evidence/facts/refusal boundaries, not candidate grades, ranking pools, or any newly captured answer.

controlled_variables.identity_checks: Save hashes of protocol, annotations, aliases, chunk files, original SQLite snapshot, vector artifacts, relevant source modules, model/settings public snapshot, Python/SQLite/PG versions, and Git revision. Never emit credentials.

keyword_compatibility.oracle: Load frozen legacy_keyword_module by its verified file hash and query frozen SQLitePath; do not infer baseline from the new backend.
keyword_compatibility.primary_inputs: All 21 development execution inputs, retaining case and input_variant identity. Raw keyword receives original current question; history is recorded but not rewritten into keyword queries.
filter_matrix: literal section substrings including percent, underscore and backslash
explicit RetrievalPlan years, year range, people and intent
comparison: public scores exactly at existing six-decimal precision
keyword_compatibility.tie_policy: Report strict order and tie-only order differences separately. Do not hide tie drift: hybrid uses ranks, so production-stage parity remains required.
keyword_compatibility.threshold: Zero missing/extra results, unequal public scores, unequal hit fields or unexplained ordering changes in the frozen workload. This is compatibility evidence, not Golden answer quality.

real_annotation_metrics.recall: Matched unique required evidence groups / fixed required group count, only for human-approved cases with valid PDF hashes and exact quoted anchors.
real_annotation_metrics.precision: Relevant returned positions / K only when all returned positions have permissible human relevance judgments; otherwise null. Unreturned exhausted slots and unjudged returned positions are distinct.
real_annotation_metrics.mrr: 1 / first relevant rank only when earlier positions cannot change that rank; without human candidate judgments, null unless fully observed empty result is meaningful.
real_annotation_metrics.ndcg: Only a completely human-judged fixed pool with validated binding; otherwise null.
real_annotation_metrics.aggregation: Publish exact evaluable case IDs, numerator, denominator, unknown reasons and unchanged-unit intersection for deltas. Never score missing judgments as zero.
real_annotation_metrics.limitations: The 196 existing agent-reviewed candidate labels may be inventoried but are not upgraded to approved labels or used to claim formal Golden Precision/MRR.

synthetic_contract_metrics.status: Deterministic fully specified test corpus; not historical Golden and not human annotations.
synthetic_contract_metrics.construction: Small fixed artificial records with explicit query-token, document, year, person, section and scope membership. Freeze complete per-query relevance grades before executing either backend.
synthetic_contract_metrics.metrics: Actual Recall@K=unique relevant retrieved/relevant corpus units; Precision@K=relevant positions/K; MRR@K=1/first relevant rank or 0 if none. Empty relevant universe is N/A for Recall/MRR. Include grade-based nDCG only when its complete ideal set is specified.
synthetic_contract_metrics.separation: Keep synthetic metrics in a separate report section; never aggregate with historical cases.

process_and_answer_checks.component: 20 main inputs plus one history-isolation control; candidate_k=30, hybrid top_k=20, answer_top_k=10. Compare keyword/vector candidates, fusion, reranking and selected-context stage IDs, ordered hit fields and returned counts.
process_and_answer_checks.local_end_to_end: Run the existing recorded runtime with llm_api_key disabled on both backends. Capture route, constraints, production retrieval trace, extractive final answer, citation bundles and refusal behavior. Compare deterministic payloads excluding latency.
process_and_answer_checks.live_end_to_end: When explicitly enabled, use identical recorded model settings on both sides and preserve planner/reflection/prompt-context/answer/citation artifacts and token costs. New semantic/fact/support judgments remain null until separately reviewed; stochastic output differences are not storage regression proof.
process_and_answer_checks.context_boundary: Candidate context is not a prompt. Only captured generation_contexts can be called actual model prompt context; no-model runs mark model context and model token quality N/A.
process_and_answer_checks.answer_review: Save reviewable outputs and required-fact IDs. Do not reuse 2026-10 historical answer reviews for new captures.
process_and_answer_checks.control_denominator: The history-isolation control contributes execution cost, not an extra independent question.

cost_and_delivery.latency: Record wall time per query/stage, distinguish cold/warm observations and report corpus workload counts. Avoid asserting speed gains from unmatched cache states.
cost_and_delivery.tokens: Record actual model usage if invoked; local no-model runs have zero external calls and semantic quality remains N/A.
cost_and_delivery.artifacts: Versioned protocol, immutable baseline/candidate captures, per-query/K compatibility diffs, strict human metric availability and denominators, separate synthetic metrics, stage/answer checks, and a concise final report.
cost_and_delivery.no_overwrite: Refuse an existing output path; retain source index and baseline artifacts.
